title: Atari 2600 Dragonfire by Imagic Game Cartridge - Tested
descriptionText: The Atari 2600 DRAGONFIRE cartridge by IMAGIC is a tested video game that falls under the action and adventure genre. Specifically designed for the NTSC-U/C region (US/Canada), this game offers players an exciting gameplay experience on the Atari 2600 platform. Imagic, known for their high-quality game cartridges, brings us this classic title that will surely provide hours of entertainment for retro gaming enthusiasts.
